variant_perception_summary: Sell-side consensus (mean target ₹2,093.72, +17.3% implied upside, 18 analysts) has not caught up to the compounding-bear mechanism this engine's own earnings module flags as Critical: the margin tailwind (deferred acquisition spend) and the revenue drag (falling paying-supplier net adds) may be the same underlying SME-demand weakness expressed twice, not two offsetting forces. This engine's triangulated base case (₹1,699, -4.8%) and bear case (₹1,229, -31.1%) sit materially below the Street's target, while target-price revisions are already 16-down/1-up over 3 months -- consensus is de-rating but has not moved as far as the fundamental read here.
what_everyone_knows: Revenue growth has decelerated every year since FY23 (30.8% to 11.4% YoY in the latest quarter); paying-supplier net additions have been negative in 3 of the last 4 quarters; management itself said on the Q1 FY27 call that buyer growth is stagnating; sell-side target-price revisions are 16 down vs 1 up over 3 months and the average recommendation has drifted from Outperform to Hold.
what_is_priced_in: The current price (₹1,784.60) implies (per the reverse-DCF) only a conservative ~6.0% flat revenue CAGR over the next 8 years -- below every year of the company's actual growth in the last 5 years -- so the market has already priced in a real slowdown, just not (per the sell-side mean target of ₹2,093.72) the specific compounding-bear scenario where the margin tailwind and the revenue drag turn out to be the same problem.
what_market_may_be_missing: That the FY26-Q1 FY27 margin cushion (35.35% EBITDA margin) is a management-labelled temporary policy choice (deferred acquisition spend) set to unwind within management's own stated '2, 3 more quarters' -- so if subscriber net adds do not turn by then, both the revenue driver and the margin driver miss together, not separately, which is a materially worse and more correlated outcome than the Street's positioned optimism (a Hold-leaning but still +17%-upside mean target) implies.
edge_proof: If in the next two reported quarters (Q2 FY27 ~21-Oct-2026, Q3 FY27 ~Jan-2027) paying-supplier net adds turn and stay positive for 2 consecutive quarters WHILE EBITDA margin holds at or above ~33-34% as acquisition spend resumes on schedule, this engine's bear-leaning read is wrong and the Street's ~+17% upside target is closer to correct. If net adds instead stay negative through that window while acquisition spend is forced to resume, the compounding-bear read is confirmed and the bear case (₹1,229) becomes the more probable outcome.
killer_risk: The margin tailwind (deferred customer-acquisition spend) and the revenue drag (falling paying-subscriber net adds) are not two independent, offsetting forces but the same underlying SME-demand weakness expressed through two channels -- if so, revenue and margin miss together at the next print that forces acquisition spend to resume, rather than one offsetting the other.

EBITDA margin falls back toward or below the FY26 full-year average (33.18%) at the same time revenue growth decelerates further below Q1 FY27's 11.37% YoY
